note: Main campground of Pigeon Lake Provincial Park on the lake's west shore, six loops (A-F) in mixed forest, with a beach, boat launch, fish cleaning, playground, 10 km of trails and summer yurt comfort camping. In winter the open Loop A sites are plowed and offered at a reduced rate. Non-biting midges can swarm in spring and summer. Note (2026): a new camping loop is under construction during the 2026 season; a blue-green algae advisory has been in effect on the lake since July 21, 2026. --Claude
